scope: Native resource arithmetic and exact modular postprocessing diagnostic; incomplete Shor pipeline

primary_sources.model: two (n+1)-bit exponent registers; section 2 and classical public-point doubling setup

classical_setup: 2*n point doublings prepare P,2P,...,2^nP and Q,2Q,...,2^nQ once; cached compressed coordinates modeled as 2*(n+1)*(ceil(n/8)+1) bytes
postprocessing: Exact congruence a+b*d=0 mod prime r with synthetic known d; extended Euclid and multiply reduce, count Euclid divisions. This is not the power-of-two noisy Fourier sample recovery algorithm.
validation: Recovered d equals synthetic d and satisfies original congruence; b=0 is rejected. Composite noninvertible denominator covered by unit test.
excluded: actual point-table construction and measured timings
full power-of-two Fourier postprocessing and lattice/rational recovery
fault tolerance, physical qubits, quantum scheduling
units: Classical operation counts, coordinate bytes, logical qubits, and Toffoli bounds are separate. No wall-time conversion.
claims: Resource accounting and algebraic diagnostic only; no quantum experiment, completed Shor resource estimate, or security claim.
